Team —

Quick margin call on the options Vivek proposed: Helios is strategic but price sensitivity is high. A few notes from finance/solutions: 

- 10% discount with a 12-month hold (Option A) pushes our blended unit margin down ~6 pts given their forecasted token mix.
- Multi-year (24 mo) gives better cadence but Helios historically avoids long lock-ins.
- $50k one-time credit is doable if tied to a 18-month minimum commitment or an uplift to dedicated capacity (gives stronger runway for predictability).

Alternate compromise (recommended): 8% discount + $30k onboarding credit + a 9-month price hold, with staged capacity increase. We can include a clause that price hold only applies to models/quantization profiles explicitly listed; fallback to standard list price for new model variants. This preserves flexibility and reduces risk of model price drift.

I ran a quick sensitivity in the attached spreadsheet — shows cash impact and payback under different ramps. If we need to be more aggressive, we can make credits milestone-driven (30% after validation, 70% after full ramp).

Aditya
Director, Revenue Operations
